indicators.name: AI credit: Oracle rating and CDS, CoreWeave bonds
indicators.value: Oracle BBB- (S&P); Oracle 5y CDS ~288 bp (Oct 15); CoreWeave 9.75% 2031 notes ~78-82, yield ~15-16%
indicators.note: Secondary sources; verify against TRACE and rating agency releases. CoreWeave distress is already priced, so by protocol it alone is not a new signal.

indicators.name: Hyperscaler capex guidance
indicators.value: Big-four 2026 guidance about $700-730B, still rising; next prints late Oct 2026
indicators.note: Company earnings releases and calls. Secondary summaries used for the aggregate.

indicators.name: AI lab funding and IPO window
indicators.value: OpenAI $852B (Mar 2026 round); Anthropic reportedly ~$965B, confidential S-1 filed June 2026, IPO possibly as early as Oct 2026
indicators.note: Press reports; the S-1 is confidential and unverified.

indicators.name: DRAM contract prices and memory equities
indicators.value: Q3 2026 DRAM contract +13-18% QoQ, slowing from ~+60% in Q2 (TrendForce); memory equities down 40-56% from June highs
indicators.note: Secondary source (TrendForce). Equities have led prices by 3 to 9 months.

indicators.name: GPU rental prices (H100)
indicators.value: SemiAnalysis H100 1-yr contract index $2.35/hr (Mar 2026), up from $1.70 (Oct 2025); Uvik on-demand median $4.20 (Oct 7)
indicators.note: Secondary sources; the index reading is several months old.

indicators.name: Data center lease cancellations
indicators.value: No 2026 cancellations reported; Feb 2025 Microsoft episode (~couple hundred MW) was a false alarm

indicators.name: S&P 500 earnings revisions
indicators.value: FactSet Oct 9: Q3 2026 S&P growth est. 29.6%, raised during quarter; negative guidance 44 vs positive 72
indicators.note: FactSet Earnings Insight. Shown for context; not part of the AI count.
